summary: Radical Entertainment's open-world action series about viral superhuman powers, later re-released on PS4 and Xbox One as the Biohazard Bundle.

entries.title: Prototype

emulation.notes: Use the PC version natively rather than emulating seventh-generation releases.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC version at highest stable settings

primary.why: Prototype released on Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360 in 2009, then returned on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in the 2015 Prototype Biohazard Bundle. Windows remains the most flexible high-fidelity route for the first game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively at the highest stable settings; use the PS4/Xbox One Biohazard Bundle only as a console convenience route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Biohazard Bundle is a console re-release bundle rather than a PC replacement.
